page_title: LYO 1-0 MNT | Lyon v Montpellier 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Jeremy Stinat has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
90+5' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90+4' The current number of shots on goal is 3:6.
90+1' 1 - 0 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) puts the ball into his own net.
90+1' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
88' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
87' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Rabby Nzingoula and he is replaced by Yanis Issoufou (Montpellier).
87' The substitution has been made. Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) has replaced Issiaga Sylla.
84' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
83' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Lucas Perri to dive and make a save.
82' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and signals a foul after Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) brought his opponent down.
79' Clinton Mata (Lyon) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
78' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:12.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Jordan Veretout.
75' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Nemanja Matic is replaced by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier) is coming onto the pitch as Teji Savanier cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
73' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) comes to nothing.
72' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
72' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
69' The foul by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) was seen by Jeremy Stinat who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
69' Some great controlled play and passing from Lyon. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
66' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
65' Malick Fofana (Lyon) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
65' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles will be replaced by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon).
65' Here is a change. Ernest Nuamah is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
65' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rayan Cherki (Lyon) replacing Said Benrahma.
65' Nikola Maksimovic has picked up an injury and is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
64' It will be a substitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is ready to enter the pitch as Akor Adams walks off.
64' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Nikola Maksimovic (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.
62' Nikola Maksimovic (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' The free kick picks out Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the right post.
59' It seemed like Said Benrahma (Lyon) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
58' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
57' 6:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
55' The referee blows his whistle as Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) was too aggressive in his challenge.
55' The goal by Montpellier is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
54' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Montpellier players aren’t happy.
53' Goal! Issiaga Sylla plays a pass to the feet of Jordan Ferri (Montpellier), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
52' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Lucas Perri easily deals with the threat.

51' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) jumps high inside the box to head the rebound towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte pulls off an amazing reflex save to keep the ball out of the net. Nice goalkeeping skill!
50' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
48' The Lyon players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+2' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' The ball falls kindly for Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
45+1' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Clinton Mata (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' The game is interrupted now, Clinton Mata (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
40' Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
39' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' A brilliant individual effort! Akor Adams (Montpellier) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
34' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
30' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:6.
27' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
24' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul.
22' Said Benrahma (Lyon) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
20' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Lucas Perri stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
18' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
17' Clinton Mata (Lyon) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremy Stinat interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
16' Montpellier hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is able to continue to play.
13' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
12' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
10' Malick Fofana (Lyon) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes it short.
7' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Malick Fofana (Lyon) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
4' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
4' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
3' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Lucas Perri keeps it out with an amazing save.
3' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Lucas Perri was alert and made a comfortable save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat was nominated as the referee for this game.
